column1: # The plain foods of the app: FDC id, the short name the app shows, a serving in grams (or ml) when there is a
# natural one, and "ml" for a drink. Everything else (kcal, protein, carbs, fat per 100 g) is read from the
# USDA FoodData Central download by build.py. Ids from 300000 up are Foundation Foods, the others SR Legacy.
# Drinks: SR Legacy gives 100 g; at about 1 g per ml it stands for 100 ml.
